sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 5490 of 2024
Applicant :- Yashvendra Pratap Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravi Sahu
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sharad Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with a prayer to grant an anticipatory bail
to the applicant in Case Crime No. 71 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B Ipc, Police
Station- Kotwali, District- Kanpur Nagar, during the pendency of trial.

3. After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has not pressed the
relief as sought by means of this application on merit and prayed for issuance of appropriate
direction to the concerned Courts below to decide the bail application of the applicant expeditiously.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in allowing the aforesaid prayer of the applicant.
